# Copy — every area, English beside Arabic

Verbatim, from the product's translation files: **use these exact words.** If a label you need is not here, say so rather than writing one — invented copy is how "Post a Listing" ended up on the classified pill.

One section per area. `../copy.md` gives each area's lines here and whether a KSA screen draws it: read those lines (`sed -n '<from>,<to>p'`), or grep this file — each row starts with its area, so a hit names it.
